requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 140 sqm of gross floor area, which maps directly to the surface_area column.
User prefers proximity to public transport (metro, bus, stations). Threshold set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).
Energy class C or better is preferred, so the building should be in class A1 to C. Area, capacity, and public transport requirements are outside the energy scope and are not included.

output.explanation: Filters on the four extracted requirements: surface_area >= 140, energy_class in A1–A4/B/C, mobility >= 71, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by distance from that point, nearest first. No LIMIT and no predicates beyond the extracted requirements.
